The site is live with site, operations, cron, smoke, tasks, analytics, and social capabilities; its stated brief describes a portfolio showcase with about/contact but no editorial content pipeline. Site analytics, SEO traffic, operations, and revenue telemetry are unavailable in the supplied snapshot. AI usage observability records 27 calls costing $2.14 from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-21, which does not establish return or avoidable spend.

Do not deploy, modify production configuration, change schedules, provision credentials, or spend money.
